notes: v1.25: Weight fields take numbers only as you type — digits and one decimal point, letters blocked, never a Save-time failure. Covered: Box Out Opening Weight, Dashboard Sold/Added/Return cells and Sell Amount, Add Sale Sold/Amount, Add Stock/Return weight dialogs, Correct Entry weight. Bill No./Rokar/Book stays free text (bill numbers can contain letters). Plus: Dashboard page is now scrollable (mouse wheel anywhere on the page, or drag the right scrollbar) and keyboard shortcuts are one line each in a small box with its own scrollbar, so they can actually be read — wheel over the table still scrolls the table, wheel over the shortcuts box still scrolls that box. Includes v1.24 (Space always jumps to table, not Enter), v1.23 (Bill No. renamed to Bill No./Rokar/Book everywhere), v1.22 (Sold column green only when sold, not when Opening = Returned), v1.21 (simpler live rates banner, no buttons, gold/silver only), v1.20 (live MCX banner from mcxlive.org, gold per 10 g, silver per 1 kg), v1.19 (B/Space shortcuts, sale -> Amount, 4-decimal weights, Attendance tab), v1.18 (Box Out horizontal scrolling), v1.17 (Return->Sell notification), v1.16 (return first then sell), v1.15 (version always visible), v1.14 (gold cell, autocomplete), v1.13 (gold row/field/header), v1.12 (horizontal sale row), v1.11 (keyboard Sell panel, Added column, Reset), v1.10 (manual cell entry), v1.9 (table fix), v1.8 (crash-proof startup), v1.7 (empty Return), v1.6 (keyboard-first), v1.5 (GOLD/SILVER), v1.4 (client installer), v1.3 (sale Mode/Amount/Bill No.), v1.2 (no cmd window), v1.1 (Ramanand Jewellers, gold icon).
